A charming hotel
Just a short distance from Millau and its viaduct
In a purely natural setting offering a superb view of the Millau Viaduct, the foothills of the Larzac plateau and the Tarn Valley, enjoy the welcome you deserve this in wooded park and authentic 12th century medieval castle, just a short distance from Millau at the heart of the Aveyron department.
This hotel and restaurant are your invitation to a world of relaxation, wellness and gourmet delights in exceptional surroundings. It has an outdoor pool with the Causses limestone plateaus on the horizon, a gym, a lounge/library and a billiards room. The Ch teau de Creissels - making your visit even more enjoyable!
Peace and quiet
Charm and intimacy in a beautiful building
Our comfortable rooms and junior suites, some with a contemporary atmosphere and others with a more traditional ambiance, are beautifully decorated and well equipped, and look onto the garden or the Millau Viaduct.
Some of our 22 rooms and 4 junior suites have a balcony or a private terrace... the ideal way to enjoy the Aveyron way of life.

Come and enjoy a unique experience in a ch teau near Millau and the Gorges du Tarn. Hotel Millau : a place full of history
In the heart of the History of Creissels
Converted into a hotel in 1960, enlarged in 1972, the Ch teau de Creissels has a rich history. It is the oldest hotel in Millau and could tell many stories if its walls could tell what they have seen. The castle goes back to a high antiquity, an act of 801 making mention of it. But it was Henri II of Rodez who built the castle in the 12th century in order to live in it. Then, great families of France succeeded one another among the owners. The 1st Viscount of Creissels, Raimond de Roquefeuil is none other than an ancestor of the rich Rockefeller. The Ch teau was owned by the French Crown from 1589 (the accession of Henri IV, known as "The Great") until 1628, when King Louis XIII, known as "The Just", donated it to private individuals.
Since then, this residence has often been passed on by women. Over the centuries, the building has undergone many transformations. However, the living room, the library, the reception, the restaurant rooms (former guard rooms) and the parapet walk constitute the oldest parts of the castle dating from the 12th century. The square tower was built in the 19th century, after the fire of 1814, which destroyed two thirds of the building. The ramparts were built on the terrace to hide the ruins of the part affected by the fire. Throughout these years, the Ch teau welcomed many personalities, including two bishops who, in the 19th century, had their family home there, and whose eponymous room has been preserved with its period furniture. More recently, the great lyric artist Emma Calv stayed there and left many memories. A more precise history is available on request at the reception. So don't hesitate to stay at the Ch teau de Creissels, the Millau hotel with the most history.

In the heart of the Grands Causses Regional Nature Park and just two kilometres from the centre of Millau, our charming hotel has 22 rooms and 4 suites, each with its own character, space and refined atmosphere. You can choose between the ch teau with its more typical rooms (period furniture, fireplaces, old wooden floors, thick walls) and a contemporary section, some of which have a balcony or terrace overlooking the garden.
All rooms are different, with double or twin beds. They are decorated with antique or contemporary furniture depending on the category. They are equipped with air conditioning, TV, direct dial telephone, shower room with toiletries and free Wi-Fi access. The entrance hall, lounge, library, breakfast room and restaurant are some of the oldest rooms in the building. 4 independent recharging points for electric cars are available to guests.
The hotel has one room equipped for people with reduced mobility.
Due to the particular configuration of the ch teau, some areas of the common areas may not be fully accessible to wheelchairs, as well as the swimming pool. Please contact us for further information.

How to get here
Our hotel is located in Creissels, just 3 km from the centre of Millau, 70 km from Rodez and 110 km from Montpellier.
By car
Take the A75 motorway from Paris and Clermont-Ferrand in the north, or from B ziers or Montpellier in the south.
GPS: 44.086351, 3.062026
By train
Millau SNCF train station is 6 minutes from the hotel.
Multiple daily TGV connections (Paris Montpellier).
Multiple connections to/from England, the Benelux countries and Barcelona
By plane
Rodez Airport and Montpellier Airport are an hour away
There are daily flights from Paris
There are multiple flights from various cities in France and throughout Europe.
